$comment: Copilot evaluation set (M8). Each question lists the tools a good answer uses (any of them), and checks: kpis = the answer must state these KPI values for the period (computed by the KPI service at run time), contains = substrings (case-insensitive), absent = must not appear, no tools listed = must not propose anything (all other tools only read). Every answer must also pass the number-grounding check. Run: pnpm ai:eval (configured provider) or pnpm ai:eval -- --fake.
